summary: Outlines the release cycle linking ansible-core majors to Ansible community package majors, including collection freeze, release candidates, and four-weekly minor releases.
questions: How are ansible-core and Ansible package releases related?
How often are minor releases published?
When does the collection freeze happen?
Which community package version is based on ansible-core 2.11?

answer_card.title: Ansible release cycle overview
answer_card.answer_md:
1. New ansible-core major (e.g. 2.11); it plus two prior versions are maintained.
2. Collection freeze for the community package.
3. Community package release candidates.
4. New community package major based on that core (e.g. Ansible 4.0.0 on core 2.11); only the newest is maintained.
5. Minor releases every **four weeks** for the three maintained ansible-core versions and the single community package version.
6. ansible-core feature freeze, RCs, next major, and repeat.
